items: Commorb (can get another from Sir Tiffy)
Access to the Air, Water, Earth, Fire, and Mind runecrafting altars
enemies: Slug Prince (level 62) (can only be hurt by melee)
rewards: Ability to purchase and equip Proselyte equipment.

st.t: Talk to Sir Tiffy Cashien in Falador Park.
s: Do you have any jobs for me yet?
i: Commorb (can get another from Sir Tiffy)
Commorb (can get another from Sir Tiffy)

st.t: Talk to Col. O'Niall on the pier in Witchaven, east of Ardougne.
s: Who are the important people in Witchaven?

st.t: Talk to Brother Maledict in the church.
Talk to Mayor Hobb in north west Witchaven. When Savant asks you to, scan with your commorb v2.
Talk to Holgart north of Witchaven.
Return to Col. O'Niall on the pier in Witchaven.
Enter the old ruin entrance west of Witchaven.
Push the wall just east of where you come down.
Follow the path until you reach an imposing door, and try opening it. After, try scanning with the commorb v2.
Try scanning with the commorb.
i: Commorb (can get another from Sir Tiffy)

st.t: Pick up the dead sea slug next to the imposing door.
Talk to Jorral at the Outpost, north-west of Ardougne. A necklace of passage teleports you there.
Return to Col. O'Niall on the pier in Witchaven.
Talk to Brother Maledict in the church.
Search the study desk in the Mayor's house for a page.
Talk to Ezekial Lovecraft in the fishing shop in east Witchaven for a page.
Talk to Col. O'Niall on the pier in Witchaven for a page.
Use some swamp paste on one of the page fragments.
Talk to Jeb north of Witchaven to travel to the Fishing Platform.
Talk to Bailey on the Fishing Platform.
Use the slug glue on one of the fragments.
Combine the fragments.

Long-press each page and choose its shape option to turn rune or pure essence into empty runes. Take each empty rune and use it on its respective Runecrafting Altar. Bring extra essence (~10 extra) as it is possible to accidentally destroy the essence upon creation.

i: Access to the Air, Water, Earth, Fire, and Mind runecrafting altars

st.t: Prepare to fight the Slug Prince (level 62). Only melee can hurt it. Then, enter the old ruin entrance west of Witchaven.
i: Melee weapon to fight the Slug Prince

st.t: Enter the wall just east of where you come down.
Use the runes on the imposing doors at the end of the path.
Kill the Slug Prince. Only melee can hurt it.
Report back to Sir Tiffy Cashien in Falador Park.

i: Melee weapon to fight the Slug Prince
e: Slug Prince (level 62) (can only be hurt by melee)
